how_to_fix: Use a positive fillet radius.
Select at least one valid edge or use a selector that resolves to edges.
If the kernel rejects the fillet, try a smaller radius or a simpler edge set.
possible_causes: The fillet radius is larger than the adjacent face can carry.
The selected edge runs along a narrow face.
repair: Reduce the radius to below 6 mm (e.g. 5.7) and retry.
Or select a different edge with more room on its adjacent faces.
bore_mouth.technical_details: ValueError: Fillet failed: OCC build did not complete
bore_mouth.what_happened: radius 6 mm meets or exceeds the 6 mm of face room between the failing edge and the opposite boundary of an adjacent face

how_to_fix: Use a positive chamfer distance.
Select at least one valid edge or use a selector that resolves to edges.
If the kernel rejects the chamfer, try a smaller distance or fewer edges.
possible_causes: The leg distance is larger than the adjacent face can carry.
The selected edge runs along a narrow face.
repair: Reduce the distance to below 10 mm (e.g. 9.5) and retry.
Or select a different edge with more room on its adjacent faces.
chamfer_room.technical_details: ValueError: Chamfer failed: OCC build did not complete
chamfer_room.what_happened: distance 12 mm meets or exceeds the 10 mm of face room between the failing edge and the opposite boundary of an adjacent face

how_to_fix: Use a positive fillet radius.
Select at least one valid edge or use a selector that resolves to edges.
If the kernel rejects the fillet, try a smaller radius or a simpler edge set.
possible_causes: Blending many edges with the same radius consumes the shared faces entirely.
The critical size equals half the narrowest adjacent face.
repair: Reduce the radius below 5 mm (half the narrowest shared face) so adjacent blend surfaces leave material between them.
Or blend the edges in two passes with different sizes.
critical.technical_details: ValueError: Fillet failed: OCC build did not complete
critical.what_happened: adjacent fillet surfaces meet tangentially: 2×radius = 10 mm equals or exceeds the 10 mm face room between opposite edges, leaving a zero-width face strip (degenerate)

how_to_fix: Use a positive fillet radius.
Select at least one valid edge or use a selector that resolves to edges.
If the kernel rejects the fillet, try a smaller radius or a simpler edge set.
possible_causes: The profile or upstream blend produced a smooth (G1) junction; there is no corner for the blend to fill.
repair: Remove that junction edge from the selection: there is no corner to blend.
If a visual transition is required there, it already exists — the faces are tangent by construction.
tangent.technical_details: Standard_Failure: There are no suitable edges for chamfer or fillet
tangent.what_happened: the faces meeting at a selected edge are already tangent (interior angle 180.00°), so the fillet surface degenerates to zero width for any radius
